reviews.t: This Esthetician LOVES
reviews.x: I’ve been an esthetician for 15 years and I Love this product!!!! I was in the same situation as many of the other people that wrote a review. My Clarisonic broke and I didn’t want to spend that amount of money again. 3 important factors for me was 1.That it vibrated(I didn’t just want a rotary brush, but this does both if you want). 2.Waterproof(I use mine when I shower) 3.It charged(I didn’t want to change batteries)  I read sooooo many reviews trying to decide which one to get. I’m so happy I

reviews.t: Pretty comparable to the expensive brand
reviews.x: I have had 2 clairisonics and the first I could never find a replacement cord, and the second died within a year.  At almost $150 each I decided there HAD to be something else that was similar.  This unit is as good if not possibly better than the clairisonic.  The price is right, comes with 3 attachments, I like the cradle charger, and it has 4 settings.  After the first use I could tell I will love it.  Skin already feels softer and moisturizer soaked right into my skin rather than lay on top

reviews.t: Amazing!!!
reviews.x: I love it!!! The charging capability is so convenient!!! I needed a face brush but I didn’t want to spend $200 on the Clarisonic! I found this one and I am so happy!

reviews.t: Look no further!
reviews.x: At first I was a bit skeptical about this brush.  The last one I owned had harder bristles and I was content with it.  I had to purchase this one because my old one died out after several years. This one has extremely soft bristles and and a beautiful design but I was worried the brushes were too soft to get the job done.  It does an amazing job! It has several levels of vibrations and it is gentler yet more powerful than my last one (if that makes sense).  I love the soft feel of the whole brus

reviews.t: IT WILL BLOW UP. It WILL CATCH ON FIRE.
reviews.x: So I used this for a couple of months, it was great, great product I would've recommended it. Eventually it stopped working. I left it on the charging rack for a while because I thought it wasn't charged at all. I left it there for maybe a week, and at the end of a couple of weeks I was asking my significant other why it wasn't working. It literally blew up and caught on fire. It was a small fire, BUT we had to put it out BECAUSE IT BLEW UP.  He's actually an engineer and explained to me that li

reviews.t: Not for me
reviews.x: I have been wanting a sonic cleanser for a few years and I finally decided to purchase this after reading the reviews on it. It's ok. I'm not really impressed with it. I actually just got on here to print a return label but I saw that the return window was closed last week. I used it 3 times. I would not purchase again. It's just a pain to use and I feel like it doesnt really clean my face that great since it doesnt spin, only vibrates.  I prefer a sponge or my hands. I wish I could return it.

reviews.t: Great cleansing brush and highly recommended!
reviews.x: I love Clarisonic brushes, but they are way too expensive!  This facial brush has excellent cleansing and exfoliating power, and I would say that it is very similar to Clarisonic at a much lower price point.  I like the charging cradle, the on/off sound tones, the overall look and ergonomic feel of the brush, as well and the massaging of the brush bristles.  Very relaxing and my face looks really bright and clean after using.

reviews.t: Fitting the brusg head is a hassle
reviews.x: Excellent product...My face becomes very clean after using it...immediately gets rid of all the days tiredness...Not giving 5 stars as the locking system of brushes takes a while to fix. It has to fit in the proper groove for the brush to function properly...but it takes a long time to fit the brush in correct grooves. I guess they should also include one more massage head...

reviews.t: Good quality
reviews.x: I spent a long time reading reviews to make sure I wasn't going to spend money on something that would break in a few weeks. This vibrating brush has held up well, and the battery on the first full charge lasted around 4 months without needing to be recharged. It's brilliant that the device charges from contact with the cradle and doesn't have a port directly in it. I use it in the shower without fear of water getting trapped inside. The brush is comfortable, it's easy to clean when necessary. Y

reviews.t: Did exactly as advertised and reviewed
reviews.x: My shipment arrived on time and the packaging was easy to open. Just for fun and giggles, I checked to see if the device was charged. IT WAS! I was able to use the product immediately.  Anyone that thinks they are cleansing their face/body with a facial towel will be mortified once this tiny scrubber is done sloughing off the residual dead skin/dust/dirt/makeup/oil. My face felt like velvet once this mighty machine was done. The brush bristles are soft enough to make you think its not doing anyt

reviews.t: But overall it’s a really great product. I’ve noticed a change in my complexion ...
reviews.x: This is the first brush I’ve ever purchased so I don’t have much to compare it to. But overall it’s a really great product. I’ve noticed a change in my complexion since adding this to my routine. Also the design just really works for me. I like the timer so you know when to switch to a different area. I love the charging dock and the fact that it doesn’t need batteries. For the price this is a good quality brush. The only reason I’m not giving 5 stars is because I noticed one of the brush heads

reviews.t: Want amazing skin at an amazing price?  Look no further!
reviews.x: I had a slightly less expensive brand that rotated rather than the sonic drive.  What a difference!  I researched the high end sonic facial cleansing system and the reviews were not that impressive for the price. I love the 20 second timer that indicates to go to the next zone and I did not find it too loud, as some other reviewers had mentioned.  My face feels so smooth and clean!  A high quality product, so far.  These will make great Christmas gifts for my family members!

reviews.t: Great Brush & Customer Service
reviews.x: I really enjoy using my Tec. Bean facial brush. I highly recommend purchasing one if you want clean and clear skin. Unfortunately, I experienced some problems with my brush I got. However, once contacted miropure service, their customer service was prompt and professional. They contacted me back immediately and was there to solve my problems! Great brush, great service, and great brand overall.

reviews.t: Great product, especially for the price
reviews.x: Great product, especially for the price.  My friend bought a different one on QVC for 4x's the money. So when I saw this one on Amazon I figured I didn't have much to lose. This has a very long battery life.  I've had it two months, charged it once, and used it every day.  It's still going on the original charge.  I keep it in the shower and have packed it on a couple of travel excursions.

reviews.t: Great product for the price point
reviews.x: The product is sleek, and I love the fact that it is chargeable. Most of the other products near the same price point were battery operated.  I've been really happy with the glow of my skin since I started using the product.  It would be helpful to know the difference between the different modes, and when each mode should be used. The instructions don't include that information.

reviews.t: Thank you so much! Best Product!!!
reviews.x: I ordered the 1st about 6 months ago and have been using it until now. I really love it because it has soft and doesn't fall brushes as other brand. It is easy and convenience to use since it is rechargeable by electronic. I love it a lots. I bought the 2nd to make a gift for my friend. I believe she will love it, too.

reviews.t: Recommend!
reviews.x: I've been using the electronic cleanser for few days now and I must say it has helped my skin a lot! It took off the remaining foundation/dirt that was still on my face after a normal wash. I've only used the facial brush so far and it is gentle on the skin but will get the job done of keeping it clean! I recommend

reviews.t: Works great!
reviews.x: I use mine on my face in the shower and can tell how soft my face feels after. Works great!

reviews.t: My new favorite way to wash my face
reviews.x: Great brush for a fraction of the cost of well known brands. Works just as good!

reviews.t: Three Stars
reviews.x: Expected a deeper scrub, but the rest of the product was as expected

reviews.t: Ok
reviews.x: Its ok, I preffer my brushes a tad sturdier but its alright

reviews.t: Four Stars
reviews.x: Cleans very well! Please offer replacement brushes.

reviews.t: Clarisonc quit so I tried this
reviews.x: I had a Clarisonic Pro for 12+ yrs.  It was great and I loved it.  They no longer make the Pro model and newer models are expensive and  have mixed reviews.  I decided to give this one a try and have used it daily for two weeks still on the original charge.  I did not realize you weren't supposed to use it to remove makeup.  That's  my primary need for it and it does remove my make up nicely.  I apply soap to my face and not to the brush.  Compared to Clarisonic,  brush, this one is much softer

reviews.t: absolutely worth it for the price
reviews.x: Comparing it to the $100 Clarisonic Mia - first impressions tells me it's absolutely worth it for the price. Especially if you're on the fence about getting a good facial brush. Still charging so don't have a full review yet, but the different speed settings feature is great, and brushes are extremely soft. Curious about how well it holds a charge, but first impressions are well above what I thought we would be getting.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the product as a great value and a comparable alternative to the expensive Clarisonic brand.
Many reviewers report clean, glowing, or improved skin after using the brush.
Reviewers appreciate the long battery life and convenient charging cradle.
A few reviewers mention problems, including a unit that stopped working and a safety concern about catching fire.
Some reviewers find attaching or fitting the brush head to be a hassle.
